title: Fora Travel hires Alanna Gregory as first CMO
excerpt: Alanna Gregory, who previously worked at Block, said her priorities as CMO are to make Fora an iconic brand, and grow its network.
content_html:
Exclusive

$1 billion travel agent platform Fora just landed its first CMO

By Lara O'Reilly

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Author of the CMO Insider newsletter

Destination: Fora.

Fora Travel, the AI-powered platform that links travel agents (the human kind) with people planning their vacations, has appointed its first chief marketing officer, CMO Insider can exclusively reveal.

Alanna Gregory has joined the company from Block, where she was VP of marketing.

The hire comes on the heels of Fora raising $60 million in a funding round at a $1 billion valuation. The company said it would use those funds to bolster the AI tools it offers its travel planners.

Gregory told me her immediate marketing priorities are threefold: building an iconic brand, growing its advisor network, and developing a "best in class" sales and marketing organization.

Fora's consumer play

Fora offers travel advisors tech tools and training to help them build their businesses in exchange for a cut of their sales and an annual fee. Travelers looking for an agent fill out a short questionnaire about their ideal getaways before being matched.

The company said it has more than 15,000 advisors who have booked more than $3 billion in travel since its founding in 2021.

Allen Adamson, cofounder of the marketing firm Metaforce, told me that while Fora has made ground with investors and advisors, it still needs to work on building its consumer brand.

"The CMO's job is to make a promise to travelers. Fora does not have one yet. Advisors know Fora. Travelers do not," he said.

Fora is up against formidable competition, from well-known travel brands like Expedia and Airbnb, to the AI chatbots consumers increasingly use to plan their trips.

Adamson said Fora's promise needs to center on the experience that machines can't fake: "The judgment of someone who's been there and done that, and trust."

Gregory said Fora's marketing is focused on building the future of human expertise in travel. Its core market is millennials, who are often juggling the logistics of traveling with multigenerational families, she added.

Gregory is designing Fora's marketing organization 'for the AI era'

AI is still top of mind. Gregory said Fora is investing heavily in its Reddit presence, where many of its advisors are active, given that the platform is often highly cited by LLMs.

She's also focused on designing the marketing team "for the AI era." From product marketers to data experts, the team will contribute to a centralized "context library" database containing materials on brand messaging, audience personas, and sales call transcripts, so that the entire organization is training on the same data and can automate some of their work.

Fora has already produced some buzzy marketing in the past, mainly focused on partnerships, such as its tie-up with the luggage brand Away and its launch of a concierge service with the dog-friendly airline Bark Air.

Gregory said she intends to draw on inspiration from her time working on Block's Cash App, which she said was "completely unafraid to take big, bold bets" such as its launch of the browser-based game "Cash Apples," which had a $500,000 prize pool.

"It was highly contested within the creative marketing organization, and we stuck by it," Gregory said. "It was a hit."

Gregory said that the Fora brand will similarly begin testing new marketing formats and "maybe take some of those bold bets."

价值 10 亿美元的旅行社平台 Fora 刚刚任命首位 CMO

作者：Lara O'Reilly 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。 CMO Insider 时事通讯的作者

目的地：福拉。

CMO Insider 独家透露，Fora Travel 是一个将旅行社（人类）与计划假期的人们联系起来的人工智能平台，已任命其首位首席营销官。

Alanna Gregory 从 Block 加入公司，担任营销副总裁。

在此之前，Fora 在一轮融资中筹集了 6000 万美元，估值为 10 亿美元。 该公司表示将利用这些资金来支持其为旅行规划者提供的人工智能工具。

格雷戈里告诉我，她当前的营销重点有三个：建立一个标志性品牌，发展其顾问网络，以及发展一个“一流”的销售和营销组织。

Fora 的消费者游戏

Fora 为旅行顾问提供技术工具和培训，帮助他们建立业务，以换取销售额的分成和年费。 寻找代理的旅行者在匹配之前填写一份简短的调查问卷，了解他们的理想度假胜地。

该公司表示，自 2021 年成立以来，拥有超过 15,000 名顾问，他们预订的旅行费用超过 30 亿美元。

营销公司 Metaforce 的联合创始人艾伦·亚当森 (Allen Adamson) 告诉我，虽然 Fora 已经在投资者和顾问中取得了进展，但它仍然需要努力打造自己的消费品牌。

“首席营销官的工作是向旅客做出承诺。 Fora 还没有一个。 顾问了解 Fora。 旅行者不会，”他说。

Fora 面临着强大的竞争，从 Expedia 和 Airbnb 等知名旅游品牌，到消费者越来越多地用来计划旅行的人工智能聊天机器人。

亚当森表示，福拉的承诺需要以机器无法伪造的体验为中心：“经历过、做过这件事的人的判断，以及信任。”

Gregory 表示，Fora 的营销重点是打造人类旅行专业知识的未来。 她补充说，其核心市场是千禧一代，他们经常需要处理与多代家庭一起旅行的后勤问题。

Gregory 正在为“人工智能时代”设计 Fora 的营销组织

人工智能仍然是首要考虑因素。 Gregory 表示，Fora 正在对其 Reddit 业务进行大力投资，鉴于该平台经常受到法学硕士的高度引用，其许多顾问都非常活跃。

她还专注于设计“人工智能时代”的营销团队。 从产品营销人员到数据专家，该团队将为一个集中的“上下文库”数据库做出贡献，其中包含有关品牌消息、受众角色和销售电话记录的材料，以便整个组织都在使用相同的数据进行培训，并可以自动化一些工作。

Fora 过去已经进行过一些热闹的营销活动，主要集中在合作伙伴关系上，例如与行李箱品牌 Away 的合作，以及与爱狗航空公司 Bark Air 推出的礼宾服务。

Gregory 表示，她打算从自己在 Block 的 Cash App 工作中汲取灵感，她说该应用程序“完全不畏惧大而大胆的赌注”，例如推出了基于浏览器的游戏“Cash Apples”，该游戏的奖金池为 50 万美元。

格雷戈里说：“创意营销组织内部对此展开了激烈的争论，但我们坚持了下来。” “这很受欢迎。”

格雷戈里表示，Fora 品牌将同样开始测试新的营销模式，并“也许会采取一些大胆的赌注”。
